Sandbox_LGTankerFuelBridge_RefillRange_t: Maximum tile distance between an enabled plumbing barrel and a supported tanker. Default: 5 tiles.
Sandbox_LGTankerFuelBridge_LitresPerTenM: Maximum litres transferred in either direction during each 10 in-game minute interval. Range: 1–1000 L. Default: 10 L.
Sandbox_LGTankerFuelBridge_Debug_tooltip: Write a diagnostic summary every 10 in-game minutes, including detected tankers, eligible barrels, and petrol transferred.
